changes: Fresh-catalog-selected SKILL.md is read as native UID only from the registered project or fixed user/CODEX_HOME/plugin/admin skill roots. All path components reject symlinks; files are regular, single-link, stable UTF-8 without NUL and at most 512 KiB.

Project-relative directory resolution uses descriptor containment. Plugin preview hashes paths/content/modes, inventories up to 512 files/1024 directories/depth16/16MiB total/2MiB per file and rejects nested Git metadata, links and special files.

Version-checked binary downloads remain project scoped and read only, at most 8MiB bytes and 12MiB serialized output. Metadata exposes revisions up to that bound without expanding the text-edit budget.
Internal TypeScript adapters validate result identities/byte counts/hashes. No generic shell, arbitrary global filesystem RPC or new sudo verb was introduced.
Project skill creation/import composes existing durable mkdir/create-only write operations; each step has its own receipt and existing filenames are not silently overwritten.

tests.command: HARNESS_TEST_PYTHON=<PYTHON> node scripts/run-tests.mjs --targeted tests/runtime/skill-resources.test.ts tests/runtime/workspace.test.ts tests/tooling/select-tests.test.ts

testCorrections: An initial portable validation asserted Windows Path string separators as POSIX; the assertion now uses as_posix. The rerun passed. A concurrent plugin-sharing type error was repaired by its owner; later server typecheck passed.

hooksResearch.protocol: Pinned generated 0.164 only exposes hooks/list; no hooks/trust or hooks/config/write RPC.
hooksResearch.conclusion: Exact-definition hash trust and non-managed disable belong to CLI /hooks. Plugin install does not trust hooks. No undocumented trust store modification or bypass flag is implemented.

limits: Native path preflight and later native marketplace/share reads are not atomic; concurrent writes by the same native UID remain outside the isolation guarantee.
This helper does not expose a public arbitrary skill path. The extension owner integrates fresh catalog and registered-project identity; that integration has separate evidence.
The official CLI can discover symlinked skills; this stricter helper rejects them and reports unavailable rather than following a new scope.
No online instance changes, external sharing, external MCP, paid inference or full suite. Source is unfrozen; the archive digest identifies the exact Linux-tested snapshot.
